name: leanforge-mcp
description: MCP server for AI-driven formal proof search in Lean 4

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running proof search job. Stops all subagents immediately.

tools.name: get_mathlib_search
tools.description: Search Mathlib4 for theorems matching a natural language query.

tools.name: get_proof_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a proof search job by job_id. Returns proof on completion.

tools.name: list_attempts
tools.description: List proof attempts for a job with Lean source and compiler feedback per turn.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List all proof search jobs with status and summary.

tools.name: validate_lean
tools.description: Run Lean 4 compiler on source and return output. No job tracking, raw compile.

tools.name: submit_theorem
tools.description: Submit a theorem for formal proof search. Returns job_id immediately.

tools.name: submit_lean_file
tools.description: Submit a complete Lean 4 file with sorry placeholders directly.
